finalText:
**Big but shallow: 94 files, ~1290 hits.** Most are one repeated pattern per service.

| Zone | Files | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| `services` | 75 | Yes, locals only |
| `migrations` | 12 | No |
| `vendor` | 4 | No |
| `docs`, `lib` | 3 | No |

Four hard stops:

1. `docs/openapi.yaml` — public field, frozen by contract.
2. Right side of `WIRE` in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) — that is the wire name.
3. All 12 migrations ran in production. New migration only.
4. `vendor/reporting-sdk` — regenerated, edits get wiped.

Also risky: 125 SQL lines in 25 `repo` files name the real column. A blind replace breaks every query.
